Nia: Heads-up  new micro kit for sprint self-reviews + manager-ready snippets. Made to fit in a single Slack message. TL;DR paste below.

Omar: Can you drop both IC and manager variants? Managers love copy-paste.

Nia: Sure  two tiny variants:
IC (3 lines): Goal: <one-line> | Outcome: <metric/impact> | Evidence: <one-line + link optional>
Manager (3 lines): What I noticed: <observation> | Impact: <user/metric> | Next step: <support requested>

Riley: Add an ultra-short peer prompt please.

Nia: Peer prompt (copy): "Observed: <impact>. Example: <brief example>. One ask: <concrete suggestion>."

peopleops-bot: Uploaded: /drive/people-ops/selfreview-sprint-microkit-v1.txt (org) :white_check_mark:

Omar: Throwing this in my 1:1s tomorrow, will share any tweaks. Thanks! :raised_hands:
